recognize_zh: 單一中性球細胞質內充滿粗大深藍色顆粒，紅色的核葉只隱約可見，屬於強陽性（約 3–4 分）的 LAP 反應。
features: Single neutrophil with dense, coarse dark blue cytoplasmic granules
Red nuclear lobes only partly visible through the precipitate
Granules extend to the cell periphery
describe_en: High-power view of a leukocyte alkaline phosphatase-stained peripheral blood smear shows a single neutrophil with dense, coarse dark blue granular reaction product filling the cytoplasm, largely masking the red-stained nucleus. This represents strong positivity, approximately 3+ to 4+ on the LAP scale. A predominance of such cells would produce a high LAP score, as seen in leukemoid reactions or polycythemia vera.

ddx.vs: 2+ cells show moderate granules with the nucleus clearly visible.
Basophil granules are purple-black and overlie the nucleus on a Wright stain, whereas this blue product reflects enzymatic azo-dye precipitation with a red nuclear counterstain.
